name: OpenClaw记忆迁移
examples_zh: 将我的 OpenClaw 身份资料、长期记忆、已安装技能和 MCP 配置迁移到 WorkBuddy，并列出需要我人工确认的冲突项。
把 OpenClaw 里的 Bot 配置、频道绑定和定时任务迁移到 WorkBuddy，优先合并已有资产，不要直接覆盖同名配置。
检查 OpenClaw 到 WorkBuddy 的迁移预览，标出身份信息、记忆条目和技能依赖中无法自动合并的部分。
examples_en: Migrate my OpenClaw identity, long-term memories, installed skills, and MCP configs into WorkBuddy, then list conflicts that need manual review.
Move my OpenClaw bot settings, channel bindings, and cron jobs to WorkBuddy using a merge-first strategy instead of overwriting same-name assets.
Review the OpenClaw-to-WorkBuddy migration preview and flag identity, memory, and skill dependency items that cannot be merged automatically.
